Considering Graduate School at UNO
Affording Your Graduate Education at UNO
Scholarships, Fellowships, and Waivers
Graduate Campus Visit
Explore the boundless graduate program opportunities available to you at UNO!
90+ Graduate Program Options
With over 90 graduate programs at the master's, educational specialist, doctoral, and graduate certificate levels, UNO students are provided a variety of advanced education opportunities. In addition to weekday schedules, classes are available in the evenings, on weekends, and online to offer busy professionals numerous education options. As a graduate student at UNO, you will have the opportunity to develop independent scholarship and gain greater competence in research and other applied activities. Rigor, combined with real-world experience and innovation help create a dynamic graduate atmosphere. Explore UNO's graduate program offerings.
6:1 Graduate Student-to-Faculty Ratio
At UNO, you'll experience classes taught by renowned faculty in a setting conducive to learning. The average graduate student-to-faculty ratio is 6 to 1, providing excellent support for students of every degree level. With a faculty committed to teaching and encouraging you along the way, you will find your education at UNO attainable. UNO students learn from distinguished faculty drawn from the nation's leading graduate institutions.
Affordable Tuition Rates in Omaha
The University of Nebraska at Omaha's premier graduate education is offered at extremely competitive tuition rates, which are the most affordable in the region. Whether you are a full-time or part-time student or taking a course for professional development, you have full access to a traditional university experience on a metropolitan campus with nationally recognized faculty and an accredited curriculum.
110+ Years of Experience
UNO Office of Graduate Studies has more than 110 years of experience educating professionals and helping individuals succeed in their careers. At the University of Nebraska at Omaha, you'll experience a university dedicated to being a leading resource for graduate study, one that offers the right learning environment focused on your success.
300+ International Graduate Students at UNO
Partner your ambition with a world-class education at UNO. More than 300 international students from more than 40 different countries across the world are enrolled at UNO.
3,100+ Graduate Students at UNO
Approximately 3,100 graduate students from 40 of the United States and abroad are enrolled at UNO. UNO is big enough to provide the opportunities you want, yet small enough to provide the mentorship you need. Whatever you study, you'll learn by doing. Our hands-on opportunities, internships throughout the Omaha metropolitan area, service learning, applied research, and other collaborative activities enhance time in the classroom so you graduate ready and able to navigate your career.
Unlimited Opportunities for Growth
For many, earning a graduate degree is a way to advance in a career. For others, it's the next step toward a career as an academic. And for some it's simply the right thing to do. After you have completed your course of study and have earned your UNO graduate degree or certificate, you will find the value of your education is highly sought after and will set you on the path to not only getting your dream job but thriving in your career. The Office of Graduate Studies and the faculty in all our graduate programs are here to assist you as you explore graduate school, and we are here to support you when you choose UNO.
